no3-sr-e1.label: MI No. 3 strike rate, 2008–2023
no3-sr-e1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
no3-sr-e1.filters: Batter arriving third at the crease, regulation innings
no3-sr-e1.query: WITH appear AS ( SELECT d.innings_id, d.batter_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.batter_id UNION ALL SELECT d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id pid, MIN(d.delivery_id) first FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id, d.non_striker_id), firsts AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, MIN(first) first FROM appear GROUP BY innings_id, pid), pos AS (SELECT innings_id, pid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY innings_id ORDER BY first, pid) position FROM firsts) SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (4) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.player_out_id = d.batter_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN pos ON pos.innings_id = d.innings_id AND pos.pid = d.batter_id LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND pos.position = 3 GROUP BY year, side ORDER BY year
